title: DimensionGroupPortal
description: Control Nether and End portals per world group on multi-world Minecraft servers.
body:
# 🚀 Dimension Group Portal

### 🎉 First Stable Public Release

---

## 🌍 Built for Multi-World Servers
Dimension Group Portal is designed for **servers running multiple worlds**, no matter how they were created.

✅ Fully compatible with:
- **Multiverse-Core**
- **Any world-creating plugin**
- **Manually created worlds**
- **SMP / LifeSteal / SkyBlock / OneBlock**
- **Custom Nether & End dimensions**

> If your server has multiple worlds — this plugin is for you.

---

## ✨ Highlights
- 🔗 **Per-group Nether & End portals**
- 🧭 **World-safe portal routing**
- 🟣 **Vanilla-accurate End behavior**
- ⚡ **Lightweight & optimized**
- 📦 **No dependencies required**

---

## 🛠 Core Features
- Assign **Overworld / Nether / End** per group
- Portals never cross into other worlds
- Works perfectly with **Multiverse environments**
- Prevents portal loop & wrong End spawns
- Clean command system with **tab-completion**
- Debug mode for troubleshooting

---

## ⌨ Commands
- `/dgp help` – Show all available commands
- `/dgp reload` – Reload config without restart
- `/dgp debug on|off` – Toggle debug logs
- `/dgp whereami` – Show current world & group
- `/dgp group add|set|remove|list|info`

---

## 🧩 Platform Compatibility
- ✅ Paper
- ✅ Purpur
- ✅ Spigot
- ✅ Bukkit  
- ❌ Proxy servers (Velocity / Bungee)

---

## 📌 Notes
> This plugin is **world-plugin agnostic**.  
> If a plugin creates worlds — Dimension Group Portal supports it.

---

### ❤️ Developed by **RNR TEAM**
